card.name: Peptide hormone drug labels, linking words
card.fires_on: Small linking words, brackets or word endings right before a hormone name or abbreviation (GnRH, PTH, hCG, FSH) in labels for fertility, pituitary and parathyroid hormone products.

card.writes: It seems to push toward names and abbreviations of hormones, and away from words like chem and growth.
card.plain: It fires on small words just before a hormone name, such as FSH, hCG or PTH, in fertility and hormone drug labels.
